entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That way's the station.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We gotta find the place where that[n]journalist is so we can get some info!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The station is just past here. On the way[n]back home, we can go to Shibuya, and[n]then...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Wait, aren't we forgetting Ryuji?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The station is just past here. It's too bad[n]for Ryuji, but let's go home already.

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Doesn't that way lead us to the station?[n]Let's talk to the hawkers in this area.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.en: Just wait outside.

entries.en: You're useless.
entries.uk: З тебе жодної користі.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tch, I can't say nothin' back...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I feel bad, but I'll leave this to you guys.[n]I'll kill time somewhere nearby.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We got information on our target,[n]so let's meet up with Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.uk: Ми дістали інформацію про ціль,[n]тож на сьогодні їдьмо додому.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.en: Anyway, let's meet up with Ryuji for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, let's meet up with Ryuji for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ah, I can think about that later.[n]Let's get on the train and go home.
entries.uk: А, про це можна подумати й потім.[n]Сідаймо на потяг та їдьмо додому.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's closed. Let's try to gather information[n]for now.
entries.uk: Зачинено. Поки що спробуймо[n]зібрати інформацію.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It smells so delicious... And it's packed[n]inside. This place must be popular!

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.en: A ramen shop, eh? Everyone here is[n]eating so quietly.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, let's meet up with Ryuji for now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The food here looks delicious, but we[n]can do that later. Gathering info is our[n]top priority now.
entries.uk: Їжа тут на вигляд смачна, але це[n]потім. Зараз найголовніше — зібрати[n]інформацію.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A pawn shop? You got somethin'[n]you wanna sell?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do that later, man. Let's hurry and find[n]that place called Crossroads!
entries.uk: Потім, чувак. Знайдімо швидше той[n]заклад, «Перехрестя»!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Goodness, they sell so many different[n]things here. Do pawn shops make a lot[n]of money?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, well. Let's meet up with Ryuji[n]for now.

entries.uk: Ломбард, га? Невже вони продають[n]геть усе, що є всередині?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A sushi place, eh? It looks pretty[n]expensive.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now, let's go meet up with Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't need any more guidance,[n]right? We already have all the info[n]we need.
